title: Lower Mill Road Tract
summary: 28± acres of young planted pine with an internal creek, food-plot clearing and established roads — about an hour from both Athens and Augusta.
bullets: 28± acres with recreation, investment, and homestead potential
Conveniently located about one hour from Athens and Augusta
Paved frontage on Lower Mill Road
Established internal road providing easy access throughout the property
One-acre clearing ready for a food plot, cabin, or future homesite
Ideal for a hunting retreat, timber investment, or rural homesite
directions: From Sharon, GA head East on Raytown Road. At the stop sign continue straight onto Lower Mill Road. The property will be on your right in 0.25 miles.
